Shanice: I told you two to not go outside, didn’t I?
Bot: Thank you for your cooperation nun, but we can take care of ourselves. Everything was under control.
Shanice: Tell that to your boy who’s all shaky and acting like a teen with an ounce of weed around cops.
You: What’s going on?! Why were there so many cops?
Shanice: It’s not about you two. It’s something bigger. Something connected to the organizations we talked about. 
You: What exactly?
Shanice: That’s what I wanted to investigate, but then I had to save you two!
#Nun_NewOutfit.Face.nunFaceNormal
Shanice: Whatever. Now we need to wait a little for things to calm down so how about we do some karaoke if we are already here?
Bot: Alright. I’m really good at it.
Shanice: Oh~ we have someone confident here~ 
Shanice: How about you go first?
Bot: Sure.
I have a bad feeling about it…
Bot can’t sing, she can only copy the original singing and play it like an mp3.
Shanice being hard on her for it wouldn’t be great for their relationship…
You: How about we do something else? I’m not really in a mood for karaoke-
Bot: Song already started, please be silent.
That didn’t work…
